v: Ha in Pablo in tik yet' winhaj Timoteo, schekab' onh Jesucristo. Sko tz'ib'ejb'at jun ko carta tik t'ayex he masanil ex creyente aj Filipos, haton ex yik exxo Dios ket'ok. Junxonhej kaj yet' Cristo Jesús. Sko tz'ib'ejb'at t'ayex ex yilumal heb' creyente ta' yet' pax t'ayex ex diácono.
Aokab' ko Mam Dios yet' Kajal Jesucristo tz'ak'an swach'k'olal yet' sjunk'olal t'ayex ta'.
Ayik tzex in na'ankot t'a juntak el, swak' yuj diosal t'a ko Mam Dios eyu'uj.
Juntak el tzin lesalwi eyuj he masanil, tzin lesalwi t'a tzalajk'olal,
yujto atax he cha'annak Cristo, masanto tikne'ik, junxonhej tzonh munlaj yuj jun wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il tik.
Toxo ix syamoch Dios sk'exan he b'eyb'al. Ha tikne'ik, wojtakxo to ol munlajnhej och t'ayex, masanto ol ja jun k'uhal ayik ol jax Jesucristo.

Smojton tzin na juntzanh tik eyuj he masanil, yujto te xajan ex wu'uj. E masanil ix ex kolwaj wet'ok t'a wopisio ix yak' Dios tik. Wach'chom preso waji, ma ayik wek'nak waleli to yel jun wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il tik, ma ayik swak'anpax stek'anil heb' syak'och sk'o'ol t'ay, tzex kolwajnhej wet'ok.
Ha Dios tz'ilani to tzex in xajanej he masanil icha tz'aj onh xajanan Cristo.
Tzin tewi t'a Dios eyu'uj, yik más tze xajanej he b'a, yik syak'pax sjelanil t'ayex. Tzin k'ananpax t'ay yik syal he sik'lan tas wach' t'a skal tas chuk,
yik ol he wach' ojtakejeli tas wal juntzanh tas wach' t'a sat Dios. Tato icha chi', ol wach' tojolb'ok he pensar, yik malaj jab'ok he palta'il t'a yichanh Cristo ayik ol jaxok.
Ol wach' och Jesucristo heyet'ok, yik wach' tojolnhej ol eyutok he b'eyb'al. Tato icha chi', eyu'uj ol cheklajelok to te niwan yelk'och Dios, haxo yalji wach' lolonel chi' t'ay.
Ex wuk'tak ex wanab', tzin nib'ej snachajel junxo tik eyu'uj, to a jun ix ja t'a wib'anh tik, manh chukoklaj. Yuj jun tik swach' pukaxel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il.
Yujto a masanil heb' soldado yik winh yajal yet' masanil heb' anima ay t'a tik, ix yab' heb' to yujto tzak'an in och yuj Cristo, preso waji.

Ayik yilan heb' creyente to tek'an swutej in b'a t'a preso tik, tzijtum heb' ix stek'b'ejpax sb'a wu'uj. Maxtzak xiwlaj heb' yalanel slolonel Dios t'a tik. Ix stek'b'ej sb'a heb' yak'anoch Kajal Jesús yipok sk'o'ol.

Yel toni, ay heb' schichon sk'o'ol t'ayin, tzowajpaxk'e heb'. Yuj chi' syalel yab'ixal Cristo heb', manh smasanilok sk'o'ol heb' syaleli, tonhej syik'cha'anh sb'a heb'. Ha sna'an heb' to icha chi', más niwan syahelal swab' t'a preso tik yuj heb'. Palta ay juntzanhxo heb' tz'alanel yuj swach'il sk'o'ol yujto xajan in yuj heb'. Yojtak heb' to preso waj t'a tik yujto swaleli to yel ton wal jun wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il tik.
Palta a in tik max in nalaj juntzanh chi'. Tato t'a smasanil sk'o'ol heb' syaleli mato ma'ay, palta tzin tzalajnhej, yujto haton yab'ixal Cristo syalel heb'. Masnhej ol wach' ja in tzalajk'olal.
Yujto wojtak to wach'chom swab' sya'il tikne'ik, palta wach'nhej ol in elk'ochok, yujto wan he lesalwi wu'uj. Icha chi' ol in ajok, yujto a Yespíritu Jesucristo ayoch wet'ok.

Swak'och yipok in k'o'ol to manh ol in k'ixwoklaj. In gana tek'an ol wutok in b'a walanel ichataxon swutej in b'a. Tato icha chi', wach'chom pitzan in ma ol in chamok, wu'uj ol cheklajelta to te niwan yelk'och Cristo.
Yujto a in tik, yakb'an ay in to ek'i, haxonhej Cristo na'an wu'uj. Haxo ayik ol in chamok, ek'alxo wal wach' wiko'.
Tato ay in to ek' jab'okxo t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, syal tzin munlaj t'a Kajal Jesús. Palta, ¿b'aj am ay junok ek'al swach'il?
Max nachajlaj wu'uj. In gana tzin chami, yik elanhchamel tzin k'och b'aj ayek' Cristo, yujto a jun chi' tzin te nib'ejxo paxi.
Palta eyu'uj a ex tik, wach' hama ayin to ek' jab'okxo t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Yuj chi' wojtak sik'lab'il to ol to in ek' jab'okxo heyet'ok. Ol in kolwaj jab'okxo t'ayex yik wach' ol ex tek'k'aj t'a yik Dios, yik ol wach' ja he tzalajk'olal yujto ix eyak'och Cristo t'a he k'o'ol.
Yuj chi', ol in k'och junelxo t'ayex, yik wu'uj ol eyal wach' lolonel t'a Cristo Jesús.

Taxonhej ol in k'ochxok t'ayex mato manhxo, wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'eyb'al icha syal jun wach' ab'ix yik Cristo, yik ol wab' he pekal to tek'an ex, hanheja' junnhej pax yaj he pensar ta'. Ol wab'anpaxi to junnhej tzeyutej eyak'anoch jun wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il t'a he k'o'ol, tek'an pax tzeyutej he b'a t'ay.

Hanhejtona', ol wab' pax yuj heb' chianoch sk'o'ol t'ayonh, to max ex xiw t'a heb'. Icha chi' ol aj scheklajeli to ol b'atkan heb' t'a syahelal t'a junelnhej. Hanhejtona', icha chi' ol aj scheklajeli to ayxo ko kolnab'il, yujto icha chi' ol yutok Dios sch'oxani.
Yuj swach'k'olal Cristo ix yak' t'ayonh, manh tonhejok ay kalan kik kak'anoch Cristo chi' t'a ko k'o'ol. Ay pax kalan kik kab'an sya'il yuj.
Ha ex tik, junnhej tzeyutej he tek'b'an he b'a eyak'an eyip wet'ok. Heyilnak t'a yalanhtaxo tas wutejnak in b'a wak'an wip. Hanheja' pax tikne'ik, wan eyab'anpaxi to hanheja' tek'an swutej in b'a.
Ha Cristo tzonh iptzitani. Syak'an ko niwank'olal, yujto xajan onh yuj. Junxonhej kaj yuj Yespíritu tikne'ik. Ha tz'ak'an ko xajanej ko b'a, yuj chi' tz'ok' ko k'o'ol t'a heb' ketanima'il.

Yuj wal juntzanh tik, junxonhej pensaril tzeyutej he b'a ta'. Junxonhej tzeyutej he xajanan he b'a. Junxonhej tzeyutej he na'an masanil tasi. Junk'olal tzeyutej he b'a, yik ol wach' ja in tzalajk'olal eyu'uj.
Malajokab' junok mach syik'cha'anh sb'a, ma syak' ak'umtakil. Palta emnakilokab' tzeyutej he b'a, syalelk'ochi to más niwanokab' yelk'och junjun heb' creyente t'a he sat.
Malajokab' junok mach anhej swach'il saya'. Aokab' tas tz'aj heb' creyente smasanil yowalil sna'a.
Lajanokab' tzeyutej he pensar icha yutejnak sb'a Cristo Jesús.
Ha Cristo chi', wach'chom Dios taxoni, palta malaj yalnak ayik yaktannakkan jun b'aj ay yalan yik yet' Dios chi'. Malaj jab'ok tas snanak ayik yaktannakkan chi'.
Icha chi' aj yaktannakkan masanil yiko', skotnak, ul yak'annak och sb'a chekab'ok. Ul yak'annak aljok sb'a t'a anima'il.
Ayik ayoch anima'il chi', emnakil yutejnak sb'a, sk'anab'ajejnak wal masanil, masanto schamnak. Yak'nak wal techaj smiljicham t'a te' kulus, te k'ixwelal ajnak schami.
Yuj chi', yelxo wal te niwan yelk'och yuj Dios tikne'ik. Ha ak'jinak sb'i, a sb'i chi', anhej ek'al t'a yichanh juntzanhxo b'i smasanil.
Icha chi' yutejnak Dios, yik a ol yab'an sb'i Jesús masanil heb' ay t'a satcha'anh yet' masanil heb' ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' heb' ay pax t'a yol lu'um, ol laj em kuman heb' t'ay smasanil.
Haxo ol yalan heb': Ha Jesucristo, haton Kajal, xcham heb'. Icha chi' ol aj scheklajeli to te niwan yelk'och Dios Mamab'il.

Yuj chi', ex xajanab'il wu'uj, tze k'anab'ajejnhej, ichataxon he modo. Tzeyak' wal eyip he na'anel t'a nanamil yet' t'a xiwk'olal tas syalelk'och ko kolnab'il syak' Dios. Manhoknhej ay in ek' eyet' ta', icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a. Palta tze k'ulejnhej juntzanh tik ayik manh in ayok ek' heyet'ok.
Yujto ha Dios tz'ak'an ko na' ko k'ulan wach'il, hanheja' tz'ak'an pax ko k'ulej tas snib'ej.
Ayik tz'ak'ji he k'ulej junok tasi, manh chichonk'olalok tze k'ulej. Manh eyalub'tanhej yuj tas tz'ak'ji he k'ulej chi'.

Manh eyutej he b'a icha chi', yik wach' malaj mach ol alanok to ay he mul, ma he palta'il. Wach'chom ayex ek' t'a skal heb' anima chuk sb'eyb'al yet' heb' chuk spensar, a exxo tik, yel yuninal ex Dios, manhxalaj tas chuklaj ayoch t'ayex icha heb' chi'. Ichaokab' yilji juntzanh k'anal swewon t'a k'ik'b'alil, icha ex okab' chi' t'a skal heb'.

Tzeyal slolonel Dios yab' heb', haton jun tz'alani to ay ko k 'inal t'a junelnhej. Yuj chi' ayik ol ja Cristo, ol in te tzalaj eyu'uj, yik ol in na'ani to manh tonhejok ix wixtejek' in b'a, manh nab'anhejok in munlajel.
Wach'chom a in tik tzin cham stz'akub'ok he silab' tzeyak' t'a Dios, palta yujto tzeyak'och Dios chi' t'a he k'o'ol, tzin tzalaji. In gana tzeyab'pax jun tzalajk'olal chi' wet'ok.
Ha exxo tik, tzalajanhek, tzeyak'anpax wojtakejel he tzalajk'olal chi'.
In gana tzin chekb'at jaye'ok k'uhal winhaj Timoteo tik t'ayex, tato icha chi' snib'ej Kajal Jesús. In gana swab'i tas heyaj ta', yik ol in tzalaj t'a tik eyu'uj.
Malaj junok mach lajan spensar yet' winh t'a tik. Te ay wal och spensar winh eyu'uj.
Masanil juntzanhxo heb', anhej swach'il heb' saya', max snalaj smunlajel Cristo Jesús heb'.
Palta eyojtakxo smodo winhaj Timoteo tik. Icha syutej sb'a junok yak'an serwil smam, icha chi' syutej sb'a winh t'ayin. Smunlaj wal winh wet'ok ayik skalanel slolonel Dios.
Yuj chi', ayik ol lajwok wilani tas ol in aj t'a tik, ol in chekanb'at winh t'ayex ta'.
Swak'och Kajal Jesús yipok in k'o'ol to ol pet in b'atpax lak'an ex wila''.
Hanheja' tzin na'a to yowalil ol in chek pax winh kuk'tak Epafrodito. Ha winh kuk'tak tik, a ex he cheknakkot winh in yak' serwil t'a tik.
Snib'ej winh sb'at ex yilxikani. Te ilk'olal yaj winh eyu'uj, yujto ix eyab'i to ix pena'ayax winh t'a tik.

Yel toni, ijan wal ix cham winh, haxo Dios ix ok' sk'o'ol t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix b'oxi winh. Manhoknhej t'a winhaj Epafrodito tik ix ok' sk'o'ol Dios chi', ix ok' pax sk'o'ol t'ayin ayik ix b'oxi sk'o'ol winh chi', yik maxtzak ja junokxo in kusk'olal t'a tik.
Yuj chi', in gana spet in chek pax winh t'ayex, yik ol ex tzalajok ayik ol eyilan sk'ochxi winh, yik ol wach' satpaxel in kusk'olal t'a tik.
Tzalajk'olalokab' tze cha sk'ochxi winh t'ayex ta', yujto kuk'tak ko b'a yet' winh t'a yol sk'ab' Kajal Jesús. Ha jantaknhej heb' lajan spensar yet' winh, ayokab' yelk'och heb' t'ayex.

Ha jun winh kuk'tak tik, yujnhej to wan yak'an serwil Cristo winh, ijan wal ix cham winh. Wach'chom ijan ix cham winh yuj in yak'an serwil, palta malaj jab'ok tas ix sna winh. Ha ex tik, max yal-laj he kot in eyak' serwil, yuj chi', a winh aykot in yak' serwil he k'exulok.
Ha tikne'ik ex wuk'tak ex wanab', tzalajanhek t'a Kajal Jesús. Ha juntzanh swalb'at tik t'ayex, wach'chom walnakxob'ati, palta manh chukok walanxib'ati, yujto yowalil tze wach' ojtakejeli.
Tzeyil wal he b'a t'a juntzanh heb' chuk spensar. Chuk syutej sb'a heb', snib'ej heb' spolel jab'ok he tz'umal.

Yujto a heb' t'a wal yel schonhab' Dios, a onh ton tik. Yujto skak'em ko b'a t'ay yuj Yespíritu. Anhej Cristo Jesús skak'och yipok ko k'o'ol. Ha juntzanhxo tas sko k'ulej, max kak'ochlaj jab'ok yipok ko k'o'ol.

Ha in tik, in nanak to smoj swak'och juntzanh chi' yipok in k'o'ol, yujto in k'anab'ajejnak. Ay heb' sna'ani to syal skolchaj heb' yuj juntzanh munil sk'ulej chi'. Palta a in tik más in k'anab'ajejnak juntzanh chi' t'a yichanh heb'.
Yukub'ixial walji, wak'jinak circuncidar, yujto israel in. Yinhtilal in kan winhaj Benjamín. Hebreo in, yujto a in mam in nun, hebreo heb'. In k'anab'ajejnak wal ley Moisés, yujto fariseo in.
Wak'nak wal och in b'a t'a in religión, yuj chi' wak'nak och syahelal heb' yikxo Cristo. In k'anab'ajejnak wal masanil tastak syal ley Moisés chi', manhxa jab'ok in palta'il t'ay.
Masanilnhej juntzanh in k'ulejnak chi', wach' ton in na'ani. Haxo tikne'ik, malaj yelk'och t'ayin, yujto anhej t'a Cristo swak'och in pensar tikne'ik.

Masanilnhej juntzanh tastak wak'nak och yipok in k'o'ol chi', a tikne'ik manhxalaj yelk'och t'ayin. Yujto a junxo más niwan yelk'och t'ayin, haton wojtakanel Cristo Jesús, haton Kajal. Yu'ujnhej ix satkanel masanil juntzanh wak'nak och yipok in k'o'ol chi'. Haxo tikne'ik, icha yilji k'alem yaj t'ayin, yujto in gana tz'och Cristo wikok t'a junelnhej,

yik junxonhej tzin aj yet'ok. Ha Dios tz'alani to wach' in t'a yichanh, yujnhej to ix wak'och Cristo t'a in k'o'ol, manh yujok to ix in k'anab'ajej ley Moisés chi'. Anhej yujto skak'och Cristo t'a ko k'o'ol yuj chi' wach' onh t'a yichanh.
In gana tzin wach' ojtakejel Cristo, yik smunlajoch spoder t'ayin, haton spoder ik'annakxi pitzwok. In gana wab'an sya'il yet'ok. In gana lajan tz'aj in pensar icha ajnak spensar ayik schamnak,
yujto in gana ay walan wik in pitzwixi t'a skal heb' chamnak.

Max wal-laj tato toxo ix wak' ganar juntzanh ix wal tik smasanil, yujto ayto palta in tek'k'aj t'a masanil yik Cristo. Palta hanheja' swak' pural in b'a tikne'ik yik wach' ol in tek'k'ajok, yuj chi' ix in yawtejoch Cristo Jesús yikok.
Max wala' tato tek'an inxo, palta icha tik swutej in b'a to a tikne'ik maxtzak in nakotlaj juntzanh tas toxo ix ek'b'ati. Anhej juntzanh tas ayto palta tzin na'a. Swak'an wal wip
yik wach' ol wak' ganar, haxo in cha'an spak chi' t'a satcha'anh. Yuj wal jun spak chi', tzonh yawtejoch Dios yikok, yujto junxonhej kaj yet' Cristo Jesús.
Ha onh tek'an onhxo, yowalil icha tik skutej ko na'an junjun onh. Tato ayex manh ichok ta' he na'ani, ol kolwaj Dios heyet'ok yik ol nachajel pax juntzanhxo tik eyu'uj.
Yowalil sko b'eyb'alej jantak tas tz'ak'ji nachajel ku'uj yuj Dios.
B'eyb'alejek in b'eyb'al tik. Ha onh tik, wan ko ch'oxan jun wach' b'eyb'al tik t'ayex. Yuj chi', ilek sb'eyb'al heb' lajan sb'eyb'al ket'ok, yik tze b'eyb'alej paxi.

Ay jun tas tzijtum el walnak t'ayex. Haxo yik swalanxib'at t'ayex tikne'ik, tzin te ok'i, yujto tzijtumxo heb' chuk syutej sb'a, yuj chi' chekel to malaj yelk'och schamel Cristo t'a te' kulus t'a heb'.

Palta a heb' chi', yowalil ol satkanel heb' t'a junelnhej. Anhej tas snib'ej heb', anhej wal ta ayoch spensar heb', ichato sdiosal heb' yaj juntzanh chi'. Ay juntzanh tas sb'o heb', k'ixwub'tak. Anhej t'a juntzanh chi' syik'cha'anh sb'a heb'. Anhej wal juntzanh yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik sna heb'.
Palta a onhxo tik, ha t'a satcha'anh, hata' ayb'at ko pensar, yujto haton jun chi' ko chonhab' yaji. Wan ko tanhwan sjax ko Kolumal t'a satcha'anh chi', haton Kajal Jesucristo.

Ha ol ak'an k'exmaj jun ko niwanil malaj yelk'och tik, yik wach' lajan ol aj yet' yiko', yujto a sniwanil chi' te wach' toni. Icha chi' ol onh yutej yet' spoder, yujto ay spoder yak'an mandar masanil tasi.

Ex wuk'tak ex wanab', te xajan ex wu'uj. Ay wal in gana tzin b'at ex wila'', yujto tzin te tzalaj eyu'uj. Eyu'ujnhej toxo ix in cha spak in munlajel. Yuj chi', ex in xajanab'il, tek'an tzeyutej he b'a eyak'anoch Kajal Jesús t'a he k'o'ol.
Ha tikne'ik swalb'at t'a ix Evodia yet' t'a ix Síntique to junxonhej syutej spensar heb' ix, yujto snulej sb'a heb' ix t'a Kajal Jesús.

Ha hachxo, ach wuk'tak, yel ketmunlajwumal ko b'a, tzin k'an pawor t'ayach, yik tzach kolwaj a b'oan yaj heb' ix kanab' chi' ta', yujto a heb' ix chi', tek'an yutejnak sb'a heb' ix smunlaj wet'ok ayik wek'nak walel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il. Hanhejtona', munlajnak winhaj Clemente wet'ok yet' juntzanhxo heb'. Ha heb' chi', tz'ib'ab'ilxo sb'i heb' t'a jun libro b'aj ay ko b'i a onh ayxo ko k 'inal t'a junelnhej.
Konh tzalajek t'a masanil tiempo t'a Kajal Jesús. Swalan junelxo, konh tzalajek.
Yab'okab' he pekal heb' smasanil to wach' he pensar. Toxo ol ja Kajal Jesús.
Manh ex och ilk'olal yuj junok tasi. Ha jantaknhej tas tze na'a, alek t'a Dios, lesalwanhek. k'anek t'ay, tzeyak'anpax yuj diosal t'ay.

Tato icha chi' skutej ko b'a, ol yak' sjunk'olal Dios t'ayonh. Ha sjunk'olal ol yak' chi', maxtzak nachajel ku'uj, yujto manhxo b'ischajb'enok jantak. Ha sjunk'olal chi' tzonh ilan yet' ko pensar, yujto yik onhxo Cristo Jesús.

Haxo tikne'ik ex wuk'tak ex wanab', skak'och ko pensar t'a masanil tas yel, t'a masanil tas smoj niwan yelk'och t'a ko sat, t'a masanil tas tojol, t'a masanil tas malaj spalta'il, t'a masanil tas wach' yet' t'a masanil tas ay yelk'ochi. Hanhejtona', t'a masanil tas wach' t'a yichanh Dios yet' t'a masanil tas b'aj smoj tz'alji wach' lolonel, hata' skak'ek och ko pensar.

Tze b'eyb'alej juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al yet' juntzanhxo tas eyab'nakkan t'ayin. Ha jantak tas heyilnak yet' tas eyab'nak t'ayin, a chi' tze b'eyb'alej. Tato icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a, haxo Dios, jun tz'ak'an ko junk'olal, a ol och heyet'ok.

Ha tikne'ik, tzin tzalaj yuj Kajal Jesús, yujto ix in he nakot junelxo ayik ix eyak'ankot he kolwal t'ayin. Wojtak to hanheja' na'an in eyu'uj, palta malaj wal b'aj ix eyak'kot he kolwal t'ayin, yujto max yal eyu'uj.
Swalb'at juntzanh tik t'ayex, manh yujok to ay tas yowalil tz'och wu'uj yuj chi' swala'. Yujto toxo ix in k'ayb'ej in b'a in tzalaj yet' tas ay t'ayin.
Wojtak mheb'ail, wojtakpax b'eyumal. Ay b'aj malaj jab'ok tas ay t'ayin. Ay pax b'aj syak' sobre. Yuj chi' wach'chom b'ut'an in, ma tz'och in wejel, k'aynak in, stechajnhej wu'uj.
Stechajnhej masanil tas wu'uj, yujto syak' spoder Cristo t'ayin.
Palta a ex pax tik, te wach' ix eyutej he b'a, yujto ix eyak'kot he kolwal t'ayin ayik ay in och t'a syahelal tik, yuj chi' ichato tzeyab'pax sya'il wet' t'a tik.
Ex aj Filipos, eyojtakxo to ayik in yamannak och walanel wach' ab'ix, in kot t'a Macedonia, a exnhej ton kolwaj ex t'ayin. Ha exnhej eyak'kot in gasto ta'.
Ayik wek'nak t'a Tesalónica, eyak'nakkot chael oxel he kolwal t'ayin ta' yuj in gasto.
Manh yujok to swak'och in pensar t'a he kolwal swalanb'at juntzanh tik t'ayex. Tzin te k'echa'anh, yujto wan sniwanb'i spak heyik t'a yichanh Dios.

Ha inxo tik, manh jantakok tas ix in cha'a, tzato yak'pax sobre t'ayin tikne'ik. Ha jun he kolwal ix ul yak' winhaj Epafrodito tik, k'okb'ilnhej syab' t'ayin. Icha junok tas tz'ak'ji t'a Dios, suk'uk'i sjab', junok silab' nhusb'il te wach', icha chi' jun he kolwal tik, yujto stzalaj Dios yet'ok.
Yuj chi', a ko Diosal ol ak'an masanil tas tz'och eyu'uj. Yujto manh jantakok tas wach' ay t'ay. Haton juntzanh chi' syak' t'ayonh a onh yik onhxo Cristo Jesús tik.
Niwanokab' yelk'och ko Diosal, haton ko Mam t'a masanil tiempo. Amén.
Swak'b'at stzatzil he k'o'ol t'a sb'i Jesucristo he masanil ex yik exxo Dios ta'. Ha heb' winh kuk'tak ayek' wet' t'a tik, syak'paxb'at stzatzil he k'o'ol heb' winh.
Hanhejtona' masanil pax heb' yikxo Dios t'a tik yet' heb' creyente ayoch t'a yopisio yuj winh yajal t'a Roma tik, syak'paxb'at stzatzil he k'o'ol heb'.
Ayokab' ek' Kajal Jesucristo he yet' he masanil ta'. Amén.
